gates.name: Package integrity
gates.required_evidence: All archives open; checksums match; no missing or duplicate files; KB/Vault copies byte-identical for mirrored artifacts.

gates.name: Ontology and schema semantics
gates.required_evidence: Canonical owner decisions, schema semantic review, full importable-record validation and migration policy.

gates.name: Instructional completeness
gates.required_evidence: Strict 216/216 full teaching-pack ledger; claim-to-source verification; subject review.

gates.name: Assessment quality
gates.required_evidence: Assessment review, double-rater scoring, disagreement resolution and learner evidence.

gates.name: Safety and safeguarding
gates.required_evidence: Qualified review of all high/critical-risk content; incident escalation; Bangladesh legal check; privacy review.

gates.name: Accessibility and localization
gates.required_evidence: P0 checklist passed on target Android and desktop; Bangla/English human review; disabled-user testing.

gates.name: App import lifecycle
gates.required_evidence: All 40 importer cases executed in actual app; preview, approval, atomicity, rollback, backup/restore and round trip evidenced.

gates.name: Learner pilot
gates.required_evidence: Approved protocol, guardian consent/assent where applicable, anonymised findings, defects and retest.

gates.name: Resource and legal freshness
gates.required_evidence: Broken-link/access sweep; jurisdiction/source/licence verification; emergency info rechecked.

gates.name: Operational readiness
gates.required_evidence: Backup recovery, offline use, sync conflict resolution, deletion/export, notification and device tests.

gates.name: Release decision
gates.required_evidence: All P0 gates closed, no unresolved critical/high severity safety/privacy issue, signed owner decision and release notes.
